articles.title_en: Weak-instrument-robust subvector inference in instrumental variables regression: A subvector Lagrange multiplier test and properties of subvector Anderson-Rubin confidence sets
articles.title_cn: 工具变量回归中的弱工具鲁棒子向量推理：子向量拉格朗日乘子检验和子向量Anderson-Rubin置信集的属性
articles.abstract_en: We propose a weak-instrument-robust subvector Lagrange multiplier test for instrumental variables regression. We show that it is asymptotically size-correct under a technical condition or as the number of instruments grows to infinity. This is the first weak-instrument-robust subvector test for instrumental variables regression to recover the degrees of freedom of the commonly used non-weak-instrument-robust Wald test. Additionally, we provide a closed-form solution for subvector confidence sets obtained by inverting the subvector Anderson-Rubin test. We show that they are centered around a k-class estimator. We show that the subvector confidence sets for single coefficients of the causal parameter are jointly bounded if and only if Anderson’s likelihood-ratio test rejects the null hypothesis that the first-stage regression parameter is of reduced rank, that is, that the causal parameter is not identified. Finally, we show that if a confidence set obtained by inverting the Anderson-Rubin test is bounded and nonempty, it is equal to a Wald-based confidence set with a data-dependent confidence level. We explicitly compute this Wald-based confidence set and its confidence level.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种用于工具变量回归的弱工具鲁棒子向量拉格朗日乘数检验。我们证明，在技术条件下或随着仪器数量增长到无穷大，它是渐近尺寸正确的。这是第一个用于工具变量回归的弱工具鲁棒子向量检验，以恢复常用的非弱工具鲁棒 Wald 检验的自由度。此外，我们还为通过反转子向量 Anderson-Rubin 测试获得的子向量置信集提供了封闭式解决方案。我们证明它们以 k 类估计器为中心。我们证明，当且仅当安德森的似然比检验拒绝第一阶段回归参数降序的零假设（即因果参数未识别）时，因果参数的单个系数的子向量置信集才是联合有界的。最后，我们证明，如果通过反转 Anderson-Rubin 检验获得的置信集是有界且非空的，则它等于具有数据相关置信水平的基于 Wald 的置信集。我们明确计算这个基于 Wald 的置信集及其置信水平。

articles.title_en: Semi-nonparametric models of multidimensional matching: An optimal transport approach
articles.title_cn: 多维匹配的半非参数模型：一种最优传输方法
articles.abstract_en: This paper develops a set of empirically tractable and flexible sieve estimators for semi-nonparametric multidimensional matching models with transferable utility, focusing on worker-job matching. We generalize the parametric quadratic-Gaussian framework employed by Bojilov and Galichon (2016) and Lindenlaub (2017), which relies on joint normality of observed characteristics. We allow unrestricted distributions of characteristics and show identification of the production technology and the equilibrium wage and matching functions using optimal transport theory. Given identification, we propose efficient, consistent, and asymptotically normal sieve estimators. We revisit Lindenlaub’s empirical application and show that, between 1990 and 2010, the U.S. economy experienced much larger technological progress favoring cognitive abilities than the original findings suggest. Furthermore, our flexible model specifications provide a significantly better fit for patterns in the evolution of wage inequality.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文针对具有可转移效用的半非参数多维匹配模型，开发了一套经验上易于处理且灵活的筛子估计量，重点关注工人-工作匹配。我们推广了Bojilov和Galichon（2016）以及Lindenlaub（2017）所采用的参数二次高斯框架，该框架依赖于观测特征的联合正态性。我们允许特征分布不受限制，并利用最优传输理论证明了生产技术以及均衡工资和匹配函数的可识别性。在识别的基础上，我们提出了有效、一致且渐近正态的筛子估计量。我们重新审视了Lindenlaub的实证应用，并表明，在1990至2010年间，美国经济经历了比原始发现所暗示的更大的有利于认知能力的技术进步。此外，我们的灵活模型设定对工资不平等演变模式的拟合显著更好。

articles.title_cn: 目标工具下的处理效应
articles.abstract_en: Multivalued treatments are commonplace in applications. We explore the use of discrete-valued instruments to control for selection bias in this setting. Our discussion revolves around the concept of targeting: which instruments target which treatments. It allows us to establish conditions under which counterfactual averages and treatment effects are point- or partially-identified for composite complier groups. We explore the additional identifying power of a positive selection assumption. We illustrate its usefulness by revisiting the findings of Kline and Walters (2016) on the Head Start Impact Study. We derive informative bounds that suggest less beneficial effects of Head Start expansions than their parametric estimates.
articles.abstract_cn: 多值处理在应用中很常见。我们探讨在此设定下使用离散值工具来控制选择偏差。我们的讨论围绕目标定位的概念展开：哪些工具针对哪些处理。这使我们能够建立条件，在这些条件下，反事实平均值和处理效应对于复合编译器组是点识别或部分识别的。我们探讨了正选择假设的额外识别力。我们通过重新审视Kline和Walters（2016）关于“启智计划影响研究”的发现来说明其有用性。我们推导出信息丰富的边界，这些边界表明启智计划扩展的益处比他们的参数估计所显示的更小。

articles.title_en: Bounding treatment effects by pooling limited information across observations
articles.title_cn: 通过跨观测有限信息汇集界定处理效应
articles.abstract_en: We provide novel bounds on average treatment effects (on the treated) that are valid under an unconfoundedness assumption. Our bounds are designed to be robust in challenging situations, for example, when the conditioning variables take on a large number of different values in the observed sample, or when the overlap condition is violated. This robustness is achieved by only using limited “pooling” of information across observations. Namely, the bounds are constructed as sample averages over functions of the observed outcomes such that the contribution of each outcome only depends on the treatment status of a limited number of observations. No information pooling across observations leads to so-called “Manski bounds”, while unlimited information pooling leads to standard inverse propensity score weighting. We explore the intermediate range between these two extremes and provide corresponding inference methods. We show in Monte Carlo experiments and through two empirical applications that our bounds are indeed robust and informative in practice.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提供了在无混杂假设下有效的平均处理效应（对受处理者）的新界限。我们的界限旨在在具有挑战性的情境中保持稳健，例如，当条件变量在观测样本中取大量不同值时，或当重叠条件被违反时。这种稳健性是通过仅使用跨观测的有限“信息汇集”实现的。具体而言，这些界限是作为观测结果函数的样本平均值构建的，使得每个结果的贡献仅取决于有限数量观测的处理状态。无跨观测信息汇集导致所谓的“曼斯基界限”，而无限制的信息汇集则导致标准的逆倾向得分加权。我们探索了这两个极端之间的中间范围，并提供了相应的推断方法。我们在蒙特卡洛实验和两个实证应用中表明，我们的界限在实践中确实稳健且具有信息量。

articles.title_en: A kernelization-based approach to nonparametric binary choice models
articles.title_cn: 基于核化方法的非参数二元选择模型
articles.abstract_en: We propose a new estimator for nonparametric binary choice models that does not impose a parametric structure on either the systematic function of covariates or the distribution of the error term. A key advantage of our approach is its computational scalability in the number of covariates. For instance, even when assuming a normal error distribution as in probit models, commonly used sieves for approximating an unknown function of covariates can lead to a large-dimensional optimization problem when the number of covariates is moderate. Our approach, motivated by kernel methods in machine learning, views certain reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces as special sieve spaces, coupled with spectral cut-off regularization for dimension reduction. We establish the consistency of the proposed estimator and asymptotic normality of the plug-in estimator for weighted average partial derivatives. Simulation studies show that, compared to parametric estimation methods, the proposed method effectively improves finite sample performance in cases of misspecification, and has a rather mild efficiency loss if the model is correctly specified. Using administrative data on the grant decisions of US asylum applications to immigration courts, along with nine case-day variables on weather and pollution, we re-examine the effect of outdoor temperature on court judges’ “mood”, and thus, their grant decisions.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种新的非参数二元选择模型估计方法，该方法不对协变量的系统函数或误差项的分布施加参数结构。我们方法的一个关键优势在于其计算可扩展性，尤其是在协变量数量方面。例如，即使假设误差分布为正态（如概率单位模型），当协变量数量适中时，常用的用于逼近未知协变量函数的筛子也可能导致高维优化问题。我们的方法受机器学习中的核方法启发，将某些再生核希尔伯特空间视为特殊的筛子空间，并结合谱截断正则化进行降维。我们证明了所提估计量的一致性，以及加权平均偏导数的插入估计量的渐近正态性。模拟研究表明，与参数估计方法相比，所提方法在模型误设情况下能有效改善有限样本性能，且在模型正确设定时效率损失相当轻微。利用美国移民法院庇护申请裁决的行政数据，以及九个关于天气和污染的案例日变量，我们重新审视了室外温度对法官“情绪”及其裁决决定的影响。

articles.title_en: Time domain estimation of non-fundamental ARMA models in the presence of heteroskedasticity of unknown form
articles.title_cn: 存在未知形式异方差时非基本ARMA模型的时域估计
articles.abstract_en: This paper considers time domain estimation of possibly non-fundamental (that is, non-causal and/or non-invertible) non-Gaussian linear ARMA models with martingale difference innovations that may display conditional heteroskedasticity of unknown form. Instead of explicitly parametrizing the underlying volatility process (the higher order dependence) and employing maximum likelihood procedures, we propose a time domain minimum distance objective function based on innovations predictability using second and third powers of past innovations. Using the proposed efficient GMM estimator, which is consistent and asymptotically normal, we estimate possibly non-fundamental ARMA models to inflation data from 29 OECD countries and find widespread evidence on non-fundamentalness.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考虑了在可能非基本（即非因果和/或不可逆）的非高斯线性ARMA模型中进行时域估计的问题，这些模型具有鞅差创新，可能表现出未知形式的条件异方差。我们不显式参数化潜在的波动率过程（高阶依赖）并采用极大似然方法，而是提出了一种基于过去创新的平方和三次方的创新可预测性的时域最小距离目标函数。使用所提出的有效GMM估计器，该估计器具有一致性和渐近正态性，我们估计了可能非基本的ARMA模型，应用于29个OECD国家的通胀数据，并发现了非基本性的广泛证据。

articles.title_en: Estimation and inference in boundary discontinuity designs: Distance-based methods
articles.title_cn: 边界不连续设计中的估计与推断：基于距离的方法
articles.abstract_en: We study nonparametric distance-based (isotropic) local polynomial methods for estimating the boundary average treatment effect curve, a causal functional that captures treatment effect heterogeneity in boundary discontinuity designs. We establish identification, estimation, and inference results both pointwise and uniformly along the treatment assignment boundary. We show that the geometric regularity of the boundary, a one-dimensional manifold, plays a central role in determining feasible convergence rates and valid inference procedures. Our theoretical contributions are threefold. First, we derive uniform lower and upper bounds on the convergence rate of the misspecification bias of isotropic local polynomial estimators. Second, we obtain uniform distributional approximations that justify boundary-robust inference. Third, we establish minimax lower bounds for a broad class of nonparametric isotropic regression estimators. These results yield practical guidance for empirical implementation, including new bandwidth selection rules that adapt to local irregularities of the treatment-assignment boundary. We illustrate the proposed methods using simulation evidence and an empirical application, and provide companion general-purpose software.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了非参数基于距离（各向同性）的局部多项式方法，用于估计边界平均处理效应曲线，这是一个在边界不连续设计中捕捉处理效应异质性的因果泛函。我们在处理分配边界上逐点和一致地建立了识别、估计和推断结果。我们表明，边界（一维流形）的几何正则性在确定可行收敛速度和有效推断程序中起着核心作用。我们的理论贡献有三方面。首先，我们推导了各向同性局部多项式估计量误设偏差收敛速度的一致下界和上界。其次，我们获得了一致分布近似，为边界稳健推断提供了依据。第三，我们为一大类非参数各向同性回归估计量建立了极小极大下界。这些结果为实证实施提供了实用指导，包括适应处理分配边界局部不规则性的新带宽选择规则。我们通过模拟证据和一个实证应用说明了所提出的方法，并提供了配套的通用软件。

articles.title_en: Estimation of characteristics-based quantile factor models
articles.title_cn: 基于特征的量化因子模型的估计
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the estimation of characteristics-based quantile factor models where the factor loadings are unknown functions of observed individual characteristics, and the idiosyncratic error terms are subject to conditional quantile restrictions. We propose a three-stage estimation procedure that is easy to implement and has nice properties. The convergence rates, the limiting distributions of the estimated factors and loading functions, plus a consistent selection criterion for the number of factors at each quantile are derived under general conditions. Our proposed estimators are shown to work satisfactorily when: (i) the idiosyncratic errors have heavy tails, (ii) the time dimension of the panel dataset is not large, and (iii) the number of factors differs from the number of characteristics. Further, a consistent estimation method based on quantile factor analysis and sieve regression is proposed when the factor loadings depend on additional unobserved characteristics. Monte Carlo simulations and an empirical application aimed at estimating the loading functions of the daily returns of a large panel of S&P 500 index securities help illustrate these properties.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了基于特征的量化因子模型的估计问题，其中因子载荷是观测到的个体特征的未知函数，且特质误差项受条件分位数限制。我们提出了一种易于实现且具有良好性质的三阶段估计程序。在一般条件下，推导了估计因子和载荷函数的收敛速度、极限分布，以及每个分位数下因子数量的一致选择准则。我们提出的估计量在以下情况下表现令人满意：（i）特质误差具有重尾分布，（ii）面板数据集的时间维度不大，（iii）因子数量与特征数量不同。此外，当因子载荷依赖于额外的未观测特征时，提出了一种基于分位数因子分析和筛回归的一致估计方法。蒙特卡洛模拟和一项旨在估计S&P 500指数证券大面板日收益载荷函数的实证应用有助于说明这些性质。

articles.title_en: Distributional effects with two-sided measurement error: An application to intergenerational income mobility
articles.title_cn: 双边测量误差下的分布效应：代际收入流动性的应用
articles.abstract_en: This paper considers identification and estimation of distributional effect parameters that depend on the joint distribution of an outcome and another variable of interest (“treatment”) in a setting with “two-sided” measurement error—that is, where both variables are possibly measured with error. Examples of these parameters in the context of intergenerational income mobility include transition matrices, rank-rank correlations, and the poverty rate of children as a function of their parents’ income, among others. Building on recent work on quantile regression (QR) with measurement error in the outcome (particularly, Hausman et al. (2021)), we show that, given (i) two linear QR models separately for the outcome and treatment conditional on other observed covariates and (ii) assumptions about the measurement error for each variable, one can recover the joint distribution of the outcome and the treatment. Besides these conditions, our approach does not require an instrument, repeated measurements, or distributional assumptions about the measurement error. Using recent data from the 1997 National Longitudinal Study of Youth, we find that accounting for measurement error notably reduces several estimates of intergenerational mobility parameters.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考虑了在“双边”测量误差——即结果变量和另一感兴趣变量（“处理”）都可能存在测量误差——的情况下，依赖于结果变量与处理变量联合分布的分布效应参数的识别与估计。在代际收入流动性的背景下，这些参数的例子包括转换矩阵、秩-秩相关性以及作为父母收入函数的儿童贫困率等。基于近期关于结果变量存在测量误差的分位数回归（QR）研究（特别是Hausman等人（2021）），我们证明，在给定（i）分别针对结果变量和处理变量在其他观测协变量条件下的两个线性QR模型，以及（ii）关于每个变量测量误差的假设的情况下，可以恢复结果变量与处理变量的联合分布。除了这些条件外，我们的方法不需要工具变量、重复测量或关于测量误差的分布假设。使用来自1997年全国青年纵向研究的最新数据，我们发现考虑测量误差显著降低了几项代际流动性参数的估计值。

articles.title_cn: 多回归元异方差回归的AIC准则
articles.abstract_en: The original and corrected Akaike information criteria (AIC) have been routinely used for model selection for ages. The penalty terms in these criteria are tied to the classical normal linear regression, characterized by conditional homoskedasticity and a small number of regressors relative to the sample size. We derive, from the same principles, a general version that takes account of conditional heteroskedasticity and regressor numerosity. The new AICm penalty takes a form of a ratio of certain weighted average error variances. The classical results on asymptotic prediction optimality of AIC are extended to AICm in heteroskedastic possibly misspecified models. Further, the infeasible AICm penalty can be operationalized via unbiased estimation of individual variances. Under suitable conditions, the feasible AICm criterion differs from the infeasible counterpart up to an asymptotically negligible term, and also possesses the property of asymptotic optimality. In simulations, the feasible AICm tends to select models that deliver systematically better out-of-sample predictions than the classical criteria. In the empirical application to an impact of legalized abortion on crime reduction, AICm tends to select a more parsimonious model than non-heteroskedasticity-robust versions of AIC.
articles.abstract_cn: 原始的及修正的赤池信息准则（AIC）长期以来一直被常规用于模型选择。这些准则中的惩罚项与经典正态线性回归相关联，其特征是条件同方差性和相对于样本量而言回归元数量较少。我们从相同的原理出发，推导出一个考虑条件异方差性和回归元众多性的一般版本。新的AICm惩罚项采取某种加权平均误差方差之比的形式。关于AIC渐近预测最优性的经典结果被扩展到异方差且可能误设的模型中的AICm。此外，不可行的AICm惩罚项可以通过对个体方差的无偏估计来实施。在适当条件下，可行的AICm准则与不可行的对应准则之间的差异在渐近意义下可忽略，并且也具有渐近最优性。在模拟中，可行的AICm倾向于选择比经典准则系统性地产生更好样本外预测的模型。在关于合法堕胎对减少犯罪影响的经验应用中，AICm倾向于选择比非异方差稳健版本的AIC更简约的模型。

articles.abstract_en: This paper develops methods for the empirical analysis of singular processes, particularly in macroeconomics. A strong rationale, a well-developed theoretical framework and, as we show, empirical support exist for multivariate time series with a singular spectral density. A singular spectral density is consistent with economic theory underlying, for example, DSGE models in which the number of variables is greater than the number of structural shocks. This assumption guarantees the existence of a finite order VAR representation but there does not exist a unique probability density function with respect to the Lebesgue measure. We therefore define a density on a compact linear submanifold with respect to the Hausdorff measure and, in a Bayesian framework, develop an HMC algorithm that jointly samples coefficients, lag length, and the number of shocks. We use the proposed framework to carry out structural analysis on the US macroeconomy with fewer shocks than variables.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文开发了用于奇异过程实证分析的方法，特别是在宏观经济学中。对于具有奇异谱密度的多元时间序列，存在强有力的理由、完善的理论框架以及我们所示的实证支持。奇异谱密度与经济理论一致，例如，在变量数量大于结构冲击数量的DSGE模型中。这一假设保证了有限阶VAR表示的存在，但不存在相对于勒贝格测度的唯一概率密度函数。因此，我们在紧致线性子流形上相对于豪斯多夫测度定义密度，并在贝叶斯框架下开发了一种HMC算法，该算法联合采样系数、滞后长度和冲击数量。我们使用所提出的框架对美国宏观经济进行结构分析，其中冲击数量少于变量数量。

articles.title_en: Identification and estimation in a time-varying endogenous random coefficient panel data model
articles.title_cn: 时变内生随机系数面板数据模型中的识别与估计
articles.abstract_en: This paper proposes a correlated random coefficient linear panel data model, where regressors can be correlated with time-varying and individual-specific random coefficients through both a fixed effect and a time-varying random shock. I develop a new panel data-based method to identify the average partial effect and the local average response function. The identification strategy employs a sufficient statistic to control for the fixed effect and a control variable for the random shock. Conditional on these two controls, the residual variation in the regressors is driven solely by the exogenous instrumental variables, and thus can be exploited to identify the parameters of interest. The constructive identification analysis leads to three-step series estimators, for which I establish rates of convergence and asymptotic normality. To illustrate the method, I estimate a heterogeneous Cobb-Douglas production function for manufacturing firms in China, finding substantial variations in output elasticities across firms that can be related to various firm characteristics.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一个相关随机系数线性面板数据模型，其中回归变量可以通过固定效应和时变随机冲击与随时间变化且个体特定的随机系数相关。我开发了一种新的基于面板数据的方法来识别平均部分效应和局部平均响应函数。识别策略采用充分统计量来控制固定效应，并用控制变量来处理随机冲击。在这两个控制条件下，回归变量中的剩余变异仅由外生工具变量驱动，因此可以用来识别感兴趣的参数。构造性识别分析导致了三步级数估计量，我为其建立了收敛速率和渐近正态性。为了说明该方法，我估计了中国制造业企业的异质性柯布-道格拉斯生产函数，发现企业间产出弹性存在显著差异，这些差异可与各种企业特征相关联。
